test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some ghosts are shells.

II. All shells are washing machines.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some ghosts are washing machines.

II. No ghost is a washing machine.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66c701a7387be649c9a2d5064e01ca0fed0a4c92afaf2d8db06863172f7f68c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec12de5272af44d17fbcc98b1cd454c6b9145fad33639e346a1dd99550c5ecde.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some ghosts are washing machines → Follow (As some ghosts are shells and all shells are washing machines. As whole shells comes in washing washing machines and have some part common with ghosts, therefore it is true.)

II. No ghost is a washing machine → Does not follow (As some ghosts are shells and all shells are washing machines. As whole shells comes in washing washing machines and have some part common with ghosts, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
